title: Biology Basics
description: Fundamental concepts in biology and life science

questions.question: What is the powerhouse of the cell?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria are known as the powerhouse of the cell because they produce ATP (energy) through cellular respiration.

questions.question: What is the process by which plants make food?
questions.explanation: Photosynthesis is the process by which plants use sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide to produce oxygen and energy in the form of sugar.

questions.question: What is DNA?
choices: The genetic material that carries information
questions.explanation: DNA (Deoxyribonucleic Acid) is the molecule that carries genetic information and instructions for the development, functioning, and reproduction of all living organisms.

questions.question: Which blood type is the universal donor?
questions.explanation: Type O negative blood is the universal donor because it can be given to people of any blood type in emergencies.

questions.question: How many chambers does the human heart have?
questions.explanation: The human heart has four chambers: two atria (upper chambers) and two ventricles (lower chambers).
